Clean — only the intended files changed, and all 11 tests pass.

`habit done <name> [date]` now accepts `yesterday`, `today`, or a `YYYY-MM-DD` date as a trailing argument (e.g. `habit done read yesterday`); an unparseable date like `2026-13-40` returns an error instead of silently becoming part of the habit name. One thing to note: something like `2026-02-30` (a real-looking but nonexistent day) silently rolls over to March 2 rather than erroring — I didn't add full calendar validation for that edge case since it seemed disproportionate for a tiny CLI tool. Let me know if you want stricter validation there.
